scope: Fresh producer-free replay of both complete controlled-gate archives
script_source:
import collections,hashlib,itertools,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
harness=Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=harness,text=True,timeout=20).strip()=='9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=harness,text=True,timeout=20).strip()
sys.path.insert(0,str(harness/'src'))
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
root=Path('/private/tmp/fq-controlled-gate-commutation-20261122/docs/development/evidence');bundle=Bundle(harness/'docs/implementation')
canonical=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
digest=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(canonical(x).encode()).hexdigest()
proof={'scope':'Fresh producer-free replay of both complete controlled-gate archives','source_commit':'9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144','draws':{}}
for draw in ('inspected','fresh'):
 source=root/f'controlled-commutation-{draw}-screen.json';index=json.loads(source.read_text());p={k:v for k,v in index.items() if k not in ('payload_files','original_observation_sha256','original_field_order')};p['payloads']={}
 for item in index['payload_files']:
  raw=(root/item['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item['sha256'];part=json.loads(raw);assert len(part)==item['payload_count'] and not set(part).intersection(p['payloads']);p['payloads'].update(part)
 p={key:p[key] for key in index['original_field_order']};reconstructed=(json.dumps(p,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode();assert hashlib.sha256(reconstructed).hexdigest()==index['original_observation_sha256'] and p['completed']
 expected={(f'{w:02d}/{f}/{t}',flow,variant,11) for w,f,t,flow,variant in itertools.product(WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,tuple(p['manifest']['configurations']),('baseline','candidate'))};actual=collections.Counter((r['case'],r['workflow'],r['variant'],r['seed']) for r in p['rows']);assert set(actual)==expected and set(actual.values())=={1}
 inputs={i['case']:i for i in p['inputs']};maximum=0;count=0
 for row in p['rows']:
  width,family,topology=row['case'].split('/');width=int(width);f=fixture(width,family,topology,p['manifest']['input_nonce']);assert digest(f)==inputs[row['case']]['fixture_sha256']
  encoded=p['payloads'][row['payload_sha256']];assert hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest()==row['payload_sha256'];payload=json.loads(encoded);payload['compile_wall_seconds']=row['compile_wall_seconds'];case=bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}'];metrics=routing(payload,f,None,case,0)
  assert row['status']=='accepted' and metrics==row['metrics'] and payload['final_layout']==list(range(width));maximum=max(maximum,metrics['max_semantic_error']);count+=1
  if count%40==0:print(json.dumps({'phase':'independent-archive-replay','draw':draw,'accepted':count}),flush=True)
 assert not {'flagquantum','qiskit','cirq'}.intersection(sys.modules)
 proof['draws'][draw]={'observation_sha256':index['original_observation_sha256'],'archive_index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'payload_files':index['payload_files'],'exact_original_bytes_reconstructed':True,'replayed':count,'maximum_semantic_error':maximum,'full_operator_rows':sum(r['metrics']['verification']=='full-operator' for r in p['rows']),'three_probe_rows':sum(r['metrics']['verification']=='three-probes-only' for r in p['rows'])}
proof.update(producer_sdks_imported=False,script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),script_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
Path('/private/tmp/fq-controlled-commutation-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='script_source'}))
